label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/feast for the next evening, with 200 fresh loaves on hall tables and eight lanterns; they planned to bring the mayor under the pretext of a hall inspection, keeping the celebration from him until then. The baker knowingly helped supply the final 24 loaves by barter, and was asked to keep the surprise private; include baker as a knowing helper rather than core organizer/participant. The mayor's later approval was only for the ostensible inspection, not the surprise.
